test_partition_by: test the partition_by method that splits a DataFrame into groups by column names or selectors
test_partition_by_single: test partition_by with a single column key to group rows and return a list of DataFrames
test_partition_by_as_dict: test partition_by with as_dict=True to return a dictionary keyed by partition values
test_partition_by_include_key_false: test partition_by with include_key=False to exclude partition columns from each partition
test_partition_by_as_dict_include_keys_f: test partition_by with as_dict and include_key=False on a large DataFrame
